newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Member of Venezuelan first family kidnapped.
newsitem.headline: Member of Venezuelan first family kidnapped.

text.p: A distant relative of Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera was kidnapped on Friday by five armed men in the western state of Carabobo, security officials said.

Josefina Sarria Pietri, who is the second cousin of Venezuelan first lady Alicia Pietri de Caldera, was kidnapped from her ranch about 155 miles (250 km) west of the capital in the western state of Carabobo, the officials said.
Sarria was initially identified by security officials as Caldera's niece.
Local police quickly arrested three men believed to be involved in the kidnapping but had not managed to locate Sarria more than nine hours later.

Police, the national guard and secret service officers were involved in the search for Sarria in a hunt across several states, national investigative police chief Jose Ramon Lazo Ricardi told local radio.
